canonicalPosts.title: How to Choose Custom Cosmetic Packaging Without Over-Specifying the Box
canonicalPosts.summary: Custom cosmetic packaging discussions should start with product dimensions, retail channel, protection needs, surface finish, insert structure and desired unboxing style. MUGE PACKAGING supports custom cosmetic packaging development for brand owners, e-commerce sellers and B2B buyers.

canonicalPosts.title: Rigid Gift Boxes: What Buyers Should Confirm Before Sampling
canonicalPosts.summary: Rigid gift boxes are used for premium cosmetics, electronics, wellness products, holiday gifts and retail sets. Buyers should confirm dimensions, weight, structure, insert requirements, surface direction and sales channel before sampling.

canonicalPosts.title: Paper Tube Packaging: A Practical Option for Premium Retail Products
canonicalPosts.summary: Paper tube packaging is used for cosmetics, tea, candles, fragrance, small gifts and specialty retail products. Buyers should compare display impact, weight suitability, closure style and surface finish before sampling.
